text: {"lessons":["My account has grown overall, but the declines in Periods 4 and 7 show that gains are not guaranteed; I should judge progress over a longer horizon and keep risk suited to my apartment goal.","Selling portions of A and E realized gains, but I should not treat past gains as proof that I can predict prices; I’ll use clear reasons and position limits for each trade.","I made no trades in most periods, which can be a valid choice; I should avoid reacting to daily price changes and invest available savings according to a consistent plan."]}
